_meta.title: Paracetamol
_meta.source_doc: Bara ICU Dosing Card 2024 / HJH ED 2026

drug.adult_dose: NAC Old Regimen: 150mg/kg in 200ml 5% Dextrose IV over 1hr, then 50mg/kg in 500ml 5% Dextrose IV over 4hrs, then 100mg/kg in 1L 5% Dextrose IV over 16hrs | NAC SNAP Protocol: 100mg/kg in 200ml 5% Dextrose IV over 2hrs, then 200mg/kg in 1L 5% Dextrose IV over 10hrs
drug.notes: Toxic dose: 150mg/kg or >10g in adults. Use nomogram to establish need for antidote. Start <8hrs if possible. If in doubt, give NAC.
